sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to supply the first item in Paul's list of appointed roles ('first of all ___'). Card 16 deliberately leaves that item out, so the answer is wording the baker hasn't seen and can't reason out. The wrong answers (elders, deacons) are equally plausible, so a pick would be luck.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
